title: Meeting Gladstone after Curfew

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shhh! I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: To my furry babies, my toothy angels.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To my furry babies, my toothy angels.
*rat noises*

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: The rats! They tell me things. Messages in their claws. You know binary code? They know it. Gnawing noughts and ones into the walls.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rats! They tell me things. Messages in their claws. You know binary code? They know it. Gnawing noughts and ones into the walls.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Many things! They scritch me secrets at night. They say the King has a plan to take over this city, one chewed cable at a time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Many things! They scritch me secrets at night. They say the King has a plan to take over this city, one chewed cable at a time.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Can't they? Well, I wish I was clever bugger like you and knew every damn thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't they? Well, I wish I was clever bugger like you and knew every damn thing.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: The rats told Thaddeus he was wrong about you. He should have listened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rats told Thaddeus he was wrong about you. He should have listened.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: The Rat King! Oh I've been trying to get an audience with him, but he won't speak to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Rat King! Oh I've been trying to get an audience with him, but he won't speak to me.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: I used to be a rat catcher. I tried to make amends, to sabotage all my old traps up topside, but the security drones know my face.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I used to be a rat catcher. I tried to make amends, to sabotage all my old traps up topside, but the security drones know my face.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: The rats would be forever grateful!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rats would be forever grateful!

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: I will give you a list of all my old traps. Find them and deactivate them. Oh, but the restaurants only put them out at night so it won't be easy...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will give you a list of all my old traps. Find them and deactivate them. Oh, but the restaurants only put them out at night so it won't be easy...

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: It is. Now, if you'll be quiet and let me listen...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is. Now, if you'll be quiet and let me listen...

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Shhh. Be quiet and let me listen...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shhh. Be quiet and let me listen...

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Secrets! The rats know many things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Secrets! The rats know many things.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: The rats told Thaddeus you were the right choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rats told Thaddeus you were the right choice.

nodes.speaker: Gladstone
nodes.text: Then leave me alone and let me listen!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then leave me alone and let me listen!
To what?
Are you ok?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have no idea what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have no idea what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have no idea what you're talking about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do they say?
Rats can't talk.
Whatever, rat man.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry. Tell me about the rats.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry. Tell me about the rats.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry. Tell me about the rats.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry. Tell me about the rats.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The King?
Well, good luck.
Why not?
Maybe I could help.
That's too bad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What would I need to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would I need to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What would I need to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What would I need to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No problem!
What's in it for me?
Leave it to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, I don't work for nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, I don't work for nothing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry, I don't work for nothing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry, I don't work for nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok...
Ahh!
